Afghan Cricketer Shapoor Zadran Dies at 38 After Rare Illness

Shapoor Zadran, a former Afghanistan cricketer, died at the age of 38 after battling a rare illness. The cause of death was an immunological disorder that led to his decline in health. Zadran's contributions to Afghan cricket and his historic win in the 2015 World Cup will be remembered by fans worldwide.
